title: A Mixed Extended Virtual Element Method for Elliptic Interface Problems on Polygonal Meshes
summary: We propose a lowest-order \(H(\operatorname{div})\)-conforming mixed extended virtual element method for elliptic interface problems on interface-unfitted polygonal meshes. The flux and pressure are approximated by subdomain-wise extended \(H(\operatorname{div})\)-VEM spaces and by piecewise constants, respectively. On cut elements, the computable polynomial projection is defined on the whole background element and then restricted to the two subdomains.
